title: Delhi's Food : From Mughals to Chaat Magic | Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan Ep 3 | Epic TV
description:
Embark on a flavorful journey through the heart of India’s capital, where every dish tells a tale. From the grandeur of Mughal kitchens to the zesty charm of Old Delhi’s iconic chaat, discover how centuries of royal, Persian, and colonial influences shaped one of the world’s most vibrant food cultures. Dive into the streets, spices, and stories that define Delhi’s timeless culinary soul.
